name: Casper Ruud

observed.title: Carlos Alcaraz vs Casper Ruud Court-Level Highlights | Paris 2026
observed.camera: court-level, behind the near player (players large and sharp)

appearance.hair: brown, short, held back by the headband

forehand.stance: wide base; on the stretch he reaches with a long straight arm and a deep bend in the front knee
forehand.takeback: early unit turn with a high, looping takeback (racket up beside the head)

running.ready: wide, upright stance behind the baseline
running.recovery: crossover then shuffle back to the middle

mannerisms: wipes his face and touches the headband walking back between points (v1 85.7-86.8)

gameHints.animator: Wide, upright ready stance; crossover to the forehand side; face-wipe walk between points.
